newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Moody's assigns ratings to Bahrain's Investcorp.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns ratings to Bahrain's Investcorp.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service assigned the following ratings for long-and short-term foreign currency debt and deposits and bank financial strength to Investcorp Bank EC and its Luxembourg-based subsidiary, Investcorp SA.
According to A statement, the following ratings were assigned to Investcorp Bank EC:
Moody's assigned the following ratings to Investcorp SA :

Moody's recognises that Investcorp has a strong track record of identifying investments, managing them and selling them at a profit, but it does not believe that the company's franchise in this area is exceptional.
Moody's believes that Investcorp's ability to place investments does constitute an exceptionally strong franchise.
Moody's believes that potential threats to this franchise arise not from rival banks, but from the risk of a downturn in the financial or political environment in the Gulf.

Such events would not necessarily result in a serious compromising of the bank's franchise although any impairment of the bank's ability to place equity in the region would have serious repercussions for the business as a whole.
The nature of the business is such that Investcorp will from time to time have to make large provisions against companies which have failed to respond to its management efforts.
Although such losses have been contained in the past, and large write-offs of major investments have hitherto been avoided, exposure to such risks is an integral part of Investcorp's business.

As a Bahrain investment bank with an offshore licence, Investcorp Bank EC is immune from many of risks associated with domicile in the State of Bahrain. Investcorp Bank EC has taken particular care to ensure that its assets would not be at risk if the operating environment in Bahrain or the region as a whole were to deteriorate.
